title: Append Mode (a, A)
instruction_text:
Learn to append text with 'a' and 'A'!

'a' = append after cursor
'A' = append at end of line (super useful!)

Your task: Add ' World' to the end of each line.

Steps:
1. Move to first line (use 'k' if needed)
2. Press 'A' to jump to end of line and enter insert mode
3. Type ' World'
4. Press ESC
5. Press 'j' to move to next line
6. Repeat: Press 'A', type ' World', press ESC
7. Save and quit with :wq
